_doc: Admin-configurable Credit Policy Matrix (P4-3). Required collateral coverage ratio per security/collateral type, as a PERCENT of the facility's KES-equivalent exposure. The CHECK is hardcoded; these THRESHOLDS are config. Tune per bank governance.
_over_secured_note: A facility is 'over_secured' when coverage_ratio exceeds required_ratio * over_secured_multiple. 1.25 => e.g. residential (125% required) is over-secured above ~156% coverage. Confirm Ecobank's real definition (some banks trigger release-of-excess-collateral here).
_valuation_note: Collateral valuation older than this fails the freshness check at the P4-6 gate.
